definitions.event_time: first point of the qualifying consecutive sequence
definitions.detection_time: last point of the qualifying consecutive sequence; the event is counted only after this point is observed
definitions.censoring: detection censor is the last observed evaluation; first-point event-time censor is the last start of an actually observed regular three-point window, or null when no such window exists
definitions.episode_matching: largest episode exposure with an evaluation observed in both runs; evaluation spacing is fixed in updates, so event-to-detection spacing in examples changes with batch size
definitions.historical_weak_escape: first one-point gap <0.14 after the first qualifying plateau stretch
definitions.descriptive_gap_differences: condition_b minus condition_a with paired seed-bootstrap 95% intervals; exploratory supplement
definitions.predictor_note: AUC requires at least five seeds in each outcome class. Acquirers-only Spearman correlations are computed with at least five eventual acquirers even when AUC is unavailable; they are selection-biased when censored, descriptive, and not causal.
